summary:
LUNAR COMMAND is an interactive Moon Base Survival Simulator designed to demonstrate the challenges of sustaining human life on the lunar south pole.

The project simulates a 30-day lunar mission with a crew of four astronauts. Users manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, electrical power and radiation shielding while monitoring crew health and greenhouse systems.

The simulator includes emergency scenarios, resource-management decisions, crew management, mission analytics, survival scoring and lunar environmental information supported by NASA scientific references.

Built using React, Vite, JavaScript, CSS, Recharts and Supabase, the platform also supports user authentication and cloud-based mission progress saving.

The goal of LUNAR COMMAND is to provide an interactive educational experience that helps users understand the environmental, engineering and resource-management challenges of establishing a sustainable human presence on the Moon.
details:
Project Title: LUNAR COMMAND

Project Category: Space Exploration and Lunar Sustainability

Project Type: Web-Based Interactive Simulation

Project Description:

LUNAR COMMAND is an interactive Moon Base Survival Simulator that explores the challenges of sustaining human life on the lunar south pole.

The project simulates a 30-day lunar mission involving a crew of four astronauts. Users must manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, electrical power, radiation shielding and greenhouse systems to ensure the crew's survival.

The simulation includes emergency scenarios, resource management, crew health monitoring, mission analytics and survival scoring. Users make critical decisions in response to changing mission conditions and unexpected events.

The platform also provides lunar environmental information and NASA scientific references to help users understand the challenges of establishing a sustainable human presence on the Moon.

Project Objectives:

  • Demonstrate the challenges of long-term lunar habitation.
  • Explore resource management and survival strategies.
  • Understand the importance of crew health and safety.
  • Simulate emergency response and decision-making.
  • Promote awareness of lunar environmental conditions.

Key Features:

  • 30-day lunar survival simulation.
  • Four-member astronaut crew management.
  • Oxygen, water, food and power monitoring.
  • Emergency event management.
  • Resource allocation and decision-making.
  • Crew health and recovery management.
  • Mission analytics and survival scoring.
  • Lunar south-pole environmental information.
  • NASA scientific references.
  • User authentication and cloud-based mission saving.

Technology Stack:

  • Frontend: React, Vite, JavaScript and CSS.
  • Data Visualization: Recharts.
  • Icons: Lucide React.
  • Authentication and Database: Supabase.
  • Deployment: Vercel.
  • Version Control: GitHub.

Project Links:

Live Website: https://lunar-command-orpin.vercel.app/

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/keerthan-m4/lunar-command

Project Goal:

To provide an interactive educational experience that demonstrates the environmental, engineering and resource-management challenges involved in establishing a sustainable human presence on the Moon.
